'''Nalan Fiskin''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorran]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In the aftermath of the [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|Battle of Balmorra]], Fiskin ran an election campaign for the new Balmorran government, in which his major opponent was a former [[Balmorran resistance]] member, [[Zenith]]. Fiskin arranged an arrest of Zenith's followers on Balmorra over an operation, which supposedly killed civilians in addition to Imperial soldiers. Zenith hit back by revealing that Fiskin once took a bribe from an Imperial official, after which hundreds of Fiskin's supporters switched over to Zenith. Zenith eventually won the election, becoming the leader of the opposition to [[Tai Cordan]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nalan Fiskin is mentioned in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' during Zenith companion storyline.
